# zerops_public_http_routing (Resource)

Editable custom HTTP routing with optional managed SSL readiness. DNS is managed externally; the provider has no Cloudflare dependency. SSL acceptance fixtures require ZEROPS_ACC_DNS=1 and tools/cloudflare-dns.sh credentials. Foreign staged project routes are refused unless forced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure external DNS before opting into wait_for_ssl. The provider never manages DNS.
# SSL acceptance fixtures use ZEROPS_ACC_DNS=1 and tools/cloudflare-dns.sh credentials.
resource "zerops_public_http_routing" "app" {
  project_id   = zerops_project.app.id
  domains      = ["app.example.com", "*.app.example.com"]
  ssl_enabled  = true
  cdn_enabled  = false
  wait_for_ssl = false
  ssl_timeout  = "20m"
  location = [{
    path = "/", port = 3000, service_id = zerops_service.app.id
    config = {
      rate_limiting = { enabled = true, rate = 10, burst = 10 }
      # basic_auth passwords, when configured, are Sensitive but remain in state.
    }
  }]
  depends_on = [zerops_service_deploy.app]
  # Null inherits provider routing_force_sync. Explicit false refuses foreign staged changes.
  force_sync = false
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `domains` (Set of String) Nonempty DNS domains, optionally prefixed with *. for wildcard routing.
- `location` (Attributes List) Ordered backend locations. Deploy HTTP backend metadata before routing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.

### Optional

- `cdn_enabled` (Boolean) Enable CDN for this route.
- `force_sync` (Boolean) Override provider routing_force_sync. Null inherits; false refuses foreign staged changes.
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Enable managed SSL. Certificate readiness is observed only with wait_for_ssl.
- `ssl_timeout` (String) Positive SSL observation timeout, capped by the operation timeout.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `wait_for_ssl` (Boolean) Wait for every configured domain to report SSL ACTIVE after synchronization. Requires ssl_enabled and external DNS.

### Read-Only

- `domain_statuses` (Attributes List) Observed raw domain statuses sorted by domain; they need not be ACTIVE. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domain_statuses))
- `id` (String) Stable editable routing ID.
- `is_synced` (Boolean) Whether the owned staged route has been applied. False schedules reconciliation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import an existing editable custom HTTP routing ID. Import never synchronizes staged changes.
terraform import zerops_public_http_routing.app ROUTING_ID
```
